en-US.author: General Action, Inc.
en-US.description: Open-source agentic development environment for running coding agents in parallel.
en-US.longDescription:
Emdash is an open-source agentic development environment for running coding agents in parallel across isolated Git worktrees.

What you can do:
- Run multiple coding agents at once without juggling terminals.
- Keep every agent isolated in its own Git worktree and branch.
- Send issues and tickets from Linear, GitHub, Jira, GitLab, Asana, Featurebase, Monday.com, Forgejo, Plain, or YouTrack into an agent.
- Review diffs, create pull requests, inspect CI checks, and merge from one place.
- Work locally or on your own remote machines over SSH/SFTP.
- Schedule recurring agent runs and preview apps in a built-in browser.
en-US.name: Emdash

zh-CN.description: 可并行运行编码智能体的开源智能体开发环境。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Emdash 是一个开源的智能体开发环境，可在隔离的 Git worktree 中并行运行编码智能体。

你可以：
- 同时运行多个编码智能体，无需在终端之间手忙脚乱。
- 让每个智能体隔离在自己的 Git worktree 和分支中。
- 将 Linear、GitHub、Jira、GitLab、Asana、Featurebase、Monday.com、Forgejo、Plain 或 YouTrack 的问题和工单发送给智能体。
- 在同一个地方审查 diff、创建 PR、检查 CI 并合并。
- 在本地或通过 SSH/SFTP 在你自己的远程机器上工作。
- 定时循环运行智能体，并在内置浏览器中预览应用。
